data_description.poll_interval: How often the hub is asked for the state of every shade. Each request makes the hub serialise its whole state document; 2 is the upstream default, 10 or more is kinder to the hub.
data_description.signal_poll_interval: How often ONE shade is asked, over the hub's serial port, for a live radio signal reading (shades take turns). The hub's own cached value does not refresh on its own on Pulse Pro hubs. While this is on, a shade whose check got no reply shows an unknown signal rather than an old number, and a Missed signal checks sensor counts those misses.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Refreshes each targeted shade's signal, position and battery right now, one shade at a time: the live radio query the signal sweep sends (the Signal sensor and the position update when the shade answers) and a request for the hub to re-read the motor (the Battery sensor updates on the next hub poll). What the shade's Refresh button does. Target a shade's cover or its Refresh button. Never moves a shade.

refresh_signal.name: Refresh signal
refresh_signal.description: Asks each targeted shade for a live radio signal reading right now, one shade at a time, the same query the live signal sweep sends; the battery is not refreshed (use Refresh for that). The shade's Signal sensor and position update when it answers. Target a shade's cover or its Refresh button. Never moves a shade.
